name: Semaglutide
summary: GLP-1 agonist that kills appetite → major weight loss. The face leans out as the body does.
note: Does not target face fat specifically — facial change rides along with total fat loss.

name: Tirzepatide
summary: Dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist — the biggest trial weight losses of any approved drug.

name: Liraglutide
summary: Daily-injection GLP-1; older and less potent than semaglutide.

name: Retatrutide
summary: Triple GLP-1/GIP/glucagon agonist in trials. Huge early numbers, still investigational.

name: Cagrilintide
summary: Long-acting amylin analogue that suppresses appetite; trialed combined with semaglutide (CagriSema).

name: Setmelanotide
summary: MC4R agonist for obesity caused by rare genetic conditions.
note: Only for those specific genetic conditions.

name: Tesamorelin
summary: GHRH analogue that cuts visceral belly fat in specific HIV patients.
note: Cannot selectively remove cheek or jawline fat.

name: AOD-9604
summary: Modified GH fragment marketed for fat loss. Human efficacy evidence came up short.

name: HGH Fragment 176-191
summary: GH fragment promoted for lipolysis. Preclinical only.

name: 5-Amino-1MQ
summary: NNMT inhibitor marketed for fat metabolism. Preclinical.

name: Berberine
summary: "Nature's metformin" — modest effects on glucose and lipid metabolism.

name: L-Carnitine
summary: Shuttles fatty acids into mitochondria; modest and inconsistent weight effects.

name: EGCG
summary: Small thermogenic and lipid-metabolism effects. Mixed data.

name: Capsaicin
summary: Chili compound; slight nudges to energy expenditure and appetite.

name: Finasteride
summary: Blocks DHT (type II 5-AR). The proven hair-loss stopper.
note: Can cause sexual and mood side effects in a minority.

name: Dutasteride
summary: Blocks both 5-AR isoenzymes — stronger DHT suppression than finasteride.

name: Minoxidil
summary: Grows hair and extends the growth phase. Topical is OTC; low-dose oral is Rx.

name: Bimatoprost
summary: Prostaglandin analogue approved for eyelash growth.

name: Pyrilutamide
summary: Topical androgen-receptor blocker developed for hair loss. Trial results mixed.

name: RU58841
summary: Gray-market topical antiandrogen. No established human safety profile.

name: Biotin
summary: Essential for hair and nail biology.
note: Only helps if you were actually deficient — most people are not.

name: Saw palmetto
summary: Botanical DHT blocker. Much weaker than finasteride.

name: Pumpkin seed oil
summary: Small studies in pattern hair loss. Preliminary.

name: Collagen peptides
summary: Supplies amino acids; hydration benefits possible.
note: A 2025 meta-analysis found skin benefits shrink or vanish in higher-quality, non-industry-funded trials.

name: Melatonin (topical)
summary: Studied for follicle cycling and antioxidant effects on the scalp.

name: Vitamin D
summary: Deficiency is linked to some hair-loss conditions and weak bones.
note: Strong when deficient; little evidence otherwise.

name: Iron
summary: Correcting deficiency can stop deficiency-related shedding.
note: Do not supplement iron blind — test first.
